requiredFindings.title: Step 6 still rechecks the original registry
requiredFindings.failureScenario: RESERVED is confirmed, so the name project-registry.v2 holds R1 and R0 is provenance. Step 6 rechecks the original registry sample before it calls the replacement primitive. That sample is R0, the name's metadata is R1's, the recheck fails, and ACTIVE never runs. The primitive's R1 reconfirm is never reached. The same sentence rechecks the original .opensip, marker and namespace observations after those names were published.

requiredFindings.title: The floor step is inside the handoff that already holds the lease
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 7 takes the lease and returns FencedNamespace with the fence still held. Item 7a joins that value and step 3 runs X3b's floor step inside the same hold. The floor is trust state. S7 writes trust state only under the fence and never under a lease, so the write is forbidden in the only place the numbered step gives it. The bullet that places the floor before X2d takes the lease cannot run from a step that starts after X2d.

scope: Law X2 r4. r3 RF-1 is not closed: step 6 still rechecks the original registry. r3 RF-2 and RF-3 are closed. Item 7a step 3 places the floor step inside the handoff that already holds the lease. No product cargo.
